sources.title: High Frequency Oscillators for Electro-therapeutic and Other Purposes
sources.date_note: Electrical Engineer, pp.477–481; transcription gives this publication date
sources.sections_read: Opening classification; synchronism/load capacitance; fatigue, burns, uncertainty; induction and condenser discussion (web lines18–26,54–74,93–118).
sources.reading_depth: Selected substantial passages of a modern historical transcription; original magazine facsimile not authenticated in this pass
sources.provenance: Tesla-authored historical article reproduced by Tesla Universe
sources.summary: Tesla described frequency-dependent electrical coupling, load-induced retuning and personal effects; he acknowledged uncertain therapeutic uses and risks. These are historical observations and proposals, not controlled clinical evidence for a universal healing frequency.
sources.model: Generic coupled lossy resonators; no body-connected device reconstruction
sources.observable: Spectral shifts under passive loading and energy balance
sources.control: Remove input; detune; change passive load
sources.unresolved: Authenticate original scan; therapeutic claims lack controlled outcomes here

sources.title: US787412A: Art of transmitting electrical energy through the natural mediums
sources.sections_read: Description: Earth-conductor assumptions and three resonance conditions, lines164–172
sources.reading_depth: Selected description, not complete patent or drawing audit
sources.provenance: Primary patent text through Google Patents
sources.summary: The patent proposes a conducting-Earth stationary-wave mechanism, an odd-quarter-wave diameter condition and a lowest rate near six per second. This differs from the later Earth–ionosphere cavity model.
sources.model: Historical condition 2R=(2k+1)c/(4f), contrasted with spherical-shell eigenmodes
sources.unresolved: Global transmission efficiency not established by this record

sources.title: US685957A: Apparatus for the utilization of radiant energy
sources.reading_depth: Selected mechanism description; drawings described in text
sources.provenance: Primary patent text through Google Patents
sources.summary: The proposal charges a capacitor using an exposed plate and an external solar or artificial radiation source. Its historical particle explanation is not evidence of a source-free generator.
sources.model: Stored energy plus external input minus load and losses
sources.observable: Cumulative input, stored energy, dissipated energy, output
sources.control: Block external input; include initial charge
sources.unresolved: Quantified efficiency and modern microscopic model not supplied by this selected reading

sources.title: Observation of Schumann Resonances in the Earth's Ionosphere
sources.date_note: NTRS catalogue labels this a preprint/draft; do not mistake 2013 acquisition or 2026 page modification for publication
sources.sections_read: PDF pp.2–5: ideal cavity equation, measured peaks, instrument description, nighttime spectral analysis
sources.reading_depth: Selected primary manuscript pages; no raw satellite data reanalysis
sources.provenance: Simões, Pfaff, Freudenreich, NASA NTRS manuscript
sources.summary: The thin lossless shell has ω_l=c√[l(l+1)]/R. Finite conductivity and losses lower observed peaks. The manuscript distinguishes average ground values from its satellite observation and gives acquisition and spectral-processing details.
sources.model: Spherical-shell eigenvalues plus driven lossy transfer functions
sources.control: Hold out higher modes; vary source and detector response
sources.unresolved: Simplified surrogate is not a full Earth simulator

sources.title: Deducing spatial characteristics of global thunderstorm activity using the observed Schumann resonance frequencies
sources.sections_read: Abstract; §1 Introduction; calibration equations near end §3; §4 Conclusions; opening Appendix A
sources.reading_depth: Selected primary paper sections; not all derivations independently checked
sources.summary: The authors explicitly distinguish forced spectral maxima from Helmholtz eigenvalues. They use multiple field/mode observations to infer source distance and extent, with site-specific calibration caveats.
sources.model: Source distribution, boundary conductivity and readout all affect observed spectra
sources.observable: Electric/magnetic peak frequencies and diurnal ranges
sources.control: Use separate modes and field components; calibrate site
sources.unresolved: Our surrogate cannot reproduce full inversion. Independent advisor reports apparent HTML Eq.(1) variable-definition inconsistency: X and Y both printed ln(df2H) although surrounding text defines vertical coordinate ln(W). Do not implement calibration before original PDF/author correction audit.

sources.title: Repetitive Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation Systems: Class II Special Controls Guidance
sources.date_note: Current official page retrieved 2026-09-26; page-header issue date not confirmed in selected reading.
sources.sections_read: §4 device description; §7–10 testing overview; Appendix A definitions
sources.reading_depth: Selected regulator document sections; not treatment advice
sources.summary: The specified output includes amplitude, pulse width, repetition frequency, train structure, coil geometry and induced field. A frequency alone does not characterize the exposure or establish efficacy.
sources.model: Field-to-tissue coupling with waveform and geometry
sources.observable: Electric field, dB/dt, pulse timing and spatial distribution
sources.control: Matched sham and independently characterized exposure in approved studies
sources.unresolved: Do not transfer device-specific evidence to audio, Schumann generators or Tesla coils

sources.title: Connectivity-guided intermittent theta burst versus repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation for treatment-resistant depression: a randomized controlled trial
sources.sections_read: Abstract; conflict statement; selected figure captions
sources.reading_depth: Abstract-level clinical appraisal only; full methods not audited
sources.provenance: Morriss et al., Nature Medicine primary randomized trial
sources.summary: The trial compares two active stimulation approaches in 255 participants and reports no significant primary-outcome difference between arms. An active-versus-active result is not sham-controlled proof for generalized frequency healing.
sources.model: Specific stimulation/targeting interventions with clinical endpoint
sources.control: Active comparator; lack of a sham arm limits causal inference beyond comparison
sources.unresolved: Cannot generalize to other exposures or conditions

sources.title: Predicting the Outcome of rTMS Depression Therapy using EEG Signals and CNN
sources.provenance: Author preprint; conference presentation noted by authors
sources.summary: The authors report time-frequency EEG classification using private datasets. Its accuracy claim is not a causal treatment result and cannot be independently reproduced from the abstract.
sources.control: Participant-level splits; label permutation; external cohort
sources.unresolved: Methods, data access and leakage controls need full audit; not admitted evidence of healing

sources.title: PSG-IPA: A PolySomnoGraphic Inter-scorer Performance Assessment database
sources.sections_read: Abstract, Methods, Data Description, Usage Notes, Ethics and License
sources.reading_depth: Dataset documentation read; data files not downloaded or analyzed
sources.summary: This release contains distinct EEG, EOG, EMG, ECG and respiratory channels with sampling rates and annotations. It supports channel-specific analysis. It has one-center and sample-size limitations; it does not measure one total human frequency.
sources.control: Units/montage/filter checks; stage-stratified windows; shuffled cross-channel alignment
sources.unresolved: No raw-data analysis executed in round 1

sources.title: MIT-BIH Polysomnographic Database
sources.sections_read: Abstract, Data Description, access/license, file inventory
sources.summary: The documentation lists simultaneous ECG, EEG and respiration recordings with annotations and open-access terms. It is a fallback resource for transparent channel-specific spectral work.
sources.model: Multichannel time series with separate units and sensors
sources.control: Timing, artifacts, state changes and filter response
sources.unresolved: No dataset values or clinical associations estimated here

sources.title: Asymmetrical Capacitors for Propulsion
sources.sections_read: Catalogue abstract; report conclusion (PDF p.20, printed p.16; extracted index P19) and preceding electrostatic-model discussion
sources.provenance: Canning, Melcher, Winet, NASA contractor report
sources.summary: The measured behavior was consistent with ions transferring momentum to surrounding gas. The conclusion did not find evidence requiring new force physics. This bounds the tested devices, not all conceivable propulsion.
sources.model: Electrostatic force on charges plus momentum exchange with gas
sources.control: Pressure, polarity, grounding configuration, full momentum budget
sources.unresolved: No apparatus replication or raw-data reanalysis here

sources.title: US10144532B2: Craft using an inertial mass reduction device
sources.sections_read: Bibliography, summary, selected description, claims 1–4, citing-family list
sources.reading_depth: Patent claim/description audit; no demonstrated performance found in inspected sections
sources.provenance: Pais patent; US Navy listed as assignee
sources.summary: The patent asserts inertial-mass reduction using resonant cavities and electromagnetic excitation. Assignment and grant establish record provenance, not a validated mass-reduction measurement.
sources.model: A new-force proposal needs a complete predictive equation plus all energy/momentum channels
sources.observable: Isolated-system center-of-mass acceleration with calibrated force residual
sources.control: Cables, thermal drift, outgassing, radiation, gas momentum and blind reversal
sources.unresolved: A reproducible quantitative mechanism and independent validation are not established here; live legal status not independently verified
